subject: Taxes
title: Marginal vs. Effective Rate
description: One-minute skill: Marginal vs. Effective Rate.

hook.text: Your marginal tax rate is the rate on your last dollar earned. Your effective rate is what you actually pay overall.

buildup.text: Someone in the 22% bracket doesn't pay 22% on everything. Lower brackets apply first, pulling the average rate down.

discovery.text: A person earning $50,000 might have a marginal rate of 22% but an effective rate of only 13%.

twist.text: Politicians use whichever rate suits their argument. 'Rich people pay 37%' is the marginal rate.

climax.text: Knowing the difference makes you immune to political manipulation about who pays 'too much' or 'too little.'

punchline.text: Marginal: your top rate. Effective: your real rate. Know the difference.

quiz.question: What is the effective tax rate?
options: The average rate you actually pay on all income
The rate on your first dollar
